title: Theresa Bridie vs. Central Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: The full Standing Judicial Commission found the complaint judicially out of order because the complainant was not a member of a PCA church and therefore lacked standing before the Commission. No merits disposition was reached.
first_summary: The SJC found Theresa Bridie's complaint against Central Florida Presbytery out of order because she was not a PCA church member and lacked standing. The source does not describe the challenged action or any merits review.
summary: Whether a non-PCA church member may bring a complaint against a presbytery? The full Standing Judicial Commission held no, finding Theresa Bridie's complaint against Central Florida Presbytery judicially out of order because she was not a member of a PCA church and therefore lacked standing. No merits issue was reached, and the sparse record does not identify the challenged presbytery action.
